result:
I added item removal, discount codes and a total-price function to `Shop.Cart` in `lib/shop/cart.ex`, with tests in `test/shop/cart_test.exs`. It compiles with no warnings, Credo (the code-style checker) reports no issues, and all 18 tests pass.

- **`remove_item/3`**: removing at least as many units as the cart holds removes the item. A SKU (stock-keeping unit, the item ID) that isn't in the cart leaves the cart unchanged.
- **`apply_discount/2`**: takes the string the customer typed. It return
